This is the start of the analysis

``` {r readsheets, include=FALSE}
googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
database.link <- "1zmYEiVVxarWLrcy2x-qMKs6-mlwCrC7P3saNnv6EPlQ" # file PCB concentrations PS https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zmYEiVVxarWLrcy2x-qMKs6-mlwCrC7P3saNnv6EPlQ/edit?gid=1030069929#gid=1030069929
db.sheet.names <- googlesheets4::sheet_names(database.link)
sheets.ignore <- c("metadata","ref_list","general_locs","locs_WSDH_2006")

sheet.data <- tidyr::tibble(sheet_name=db.sheet.names) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!sheet_name %in% sheets.ignore)

num.sheets <- 1:nrow(sheet.data)

database.values <- lapply(num.sheets, get_datasheets, sheet.data, database.link)

database.tibble <- database.values %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(functional_group=dplyr::if_else(functional_group=="Sediment","sediment",functional_group)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(concentration)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(year=as.factor(year))

readr::write_csv(database.tibble, here::here("outputs","raw_pcb_concentrations.csv"), append = FALSE)  

```

Conversions to standarize database

```{r}

database.tibble <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs","raw_pcb_concentrations.csv"))  

#standarize units

database.tibble %>% dplyr::distinct("units") %>% View()
  
```




```{r}
database.tibble %>% dplyr::filter(sample=="NA") %>% dplyr::distinct(citation) %>% View()


unique(database.tibble$year)

database.tibble %>% dplyr::filter(year=="18.8")
database.tibble %>% dplyr::filter(year=="NA") %>% View()

na.data <- database.tibble %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(concentration)) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct(citation)


conc.plot <- database.tibble %>% 
   ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x= sample, y = concentration, colour = functional_group))+
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ functional_group)+
  ggplot2::labs(title= "Congener:total PCB ratio", 
                subtitle = "West et al. 2001",
                y="Percent of total PCBs",
                x= "Atlantis polygon")

ratio.loc.plot

```
